The '''''[[Rockcan]]''''' was the personal [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of the [[Miner/Legends|miner]] [[Gideon Smith]]. The craft was a small mining vessel that had been outfitted with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. During an encounter with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Gideon Smith used the ''Rockcan'' to fly to [[24 Tredway]] and [[Tol Ado]] during the rescue mission for [[Erling Tredway]]. During this mission, the ''Rockcan'' was used to transport the injured [[Dena Tredway]] to the secret asteroid base of the [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ire Eleazari]].
